cards.say: What is one tenth as a decimal? Zero point one
What is three tenths as a decimal? Zero point three
What is zero point seven as a fraction? Seven tenths
What is one hundredth as a decimal? Zero point zero one
What is one half as a decimal? Zero point five
What is one quarter as a decimal? Zero point two five
What is three quarters as a decimal? Zero point seven five
What is one fifth as a decimal? Zero point two

cards.front: In the number 0.47, what is the 4 worth?
cards.say: In the number zero point four seven, what is the four worth? Four tenths, or zero point four

cards.front: In the number 0.04, what is the 4 worth?
cards.say: In the number zero point zero four, what is the four worth? Four hundredths, or zero point zero four

cards.back:
0.6
0.6 is the same as 0.60, and 60 hundredths is more than 58 hundredths.
cards.say: Which is bigger: zero point six or zero point five eight? Zero point six. Zero point six is the same as zero point six zero, and sixty hundredths is more than fifty eight hundredths.
Put in order, smallest first: zero point three, zero point zero three, zero point three three. Zero point zero three, zero point three, zero point three three
Fill the gap: one half equals the missing number over six. Three. One half equals three sixths.
Fill the gap: two thirds equals the missing number over six. Four. Two thirds equals four sixths.
Fill the gap: three fifths equals the missing number over ten. Six. Three fifths equals six tenths.
Write four eighths in its simplest form. One half

cards.back:
5/7
The denominators match, so add the numerators.
cards.say: What is two sevenths plus three sevenths? Five sevenths. The denominators match, so add the numerators.
What is five eighths take away two eighths? Three eighths
What is three tenths plus four tenths? Seven tenths

cards.front: What must you add to 3/8 to make 1 whole?
cards.say: What must you add to three eighths to make one whole? Five eighths. One whole is eight eighths.
What is one fifth of thirty five? Seven. Thirty five divided by five equals seven.
What is three quarters of twenty four? Eighteen. One quarter of twenty four is six, so three quarters is three times six equals eighteen.
What is two thirds of twenty one? Fourteen. One third of twenty one is seven, so two thirds is two times seven equals fourteen.
What is zero point one plus zero point two? Zero point three
What is one take away zero point four? Zero point six
